items.text: The old Warhorn interact objective has been removed, and instead the Totem of Ku will spawn within the Warhorn pit
Still uses the visuals of the Warhorn pit and will display the Warhorn accolade upon capture
Dealing damage to the Totem of Ku builds progress towards capturing the Totem
The starting damage goal is set to 600 total damage
Each time the Totem of Ku is claimed, the next goal is increased by 300
This goal will never exceed 3000 total required damage
Capturing the Totem of Ku grants the following rewards to the team
Allied structures gain an aura for 60s that grants the same effect and refreshes the duration
Additionally, the Totem will also spawn Champion minions from the previous Warhorn objective
The Totem of Ku respawns every 90s
The Warhorn pit grants an effect while the Totem of Ku is active
Gods within the pit take 20% less damage from gods outside of the pit
Infamy rewards have been updated to the following:
Rank 2: No longer grants soul charges from getting minion kills/assists, now grants +5% bonus lifesteal upon reaching max stacks
Rank 4: The bonus lifesteal is increased to +10%
Behind the Phoenix walls are new base teleporters that players can interact with to teleport to the furthest tower in that lane
There will be three teleporters total in each base
These teleporters cannot be used by the enemy team
Using a teleporter applies a 210s cooldown that prevents the player from using another base teleporter
This cooldown does not affect the usage of the side teleporters
Upon using the teleporter, players will dematerialize and move along a path towards the farthest tower that isn’t destroyed
Players can, at any point, press the Cancel button to re-materialize and end their travel
During travel, players are untargetable and cannot cast abilities, use items, or use basic attacks
When both towers in a lane have been destroyed, the teleporter will also be destroyed
Fire minions now award twice the normal amount of gold when slain
Reduced bonus damage vs. structures from 250% to 125%
When a Phoenix respawns, each member of that team gets 100 gold
When all Phoenixes are alive, the Titan gains 0.4% of its maximum health as regeneration
Ancient Fury’s debuff no longer applies to all structures
Ancient Fury will now try to choose to the frontmost structure in each lane when applying its debuff

Ancient Fury’s effect has changed from “All enemy structures are disabled for 120 seconds” to “The enemy’s frontmost structures are weakened. Their damage is reduced by 25% less damage and attack speed is reduced by 50%.”
Removed the protections reward from the Fire Giant buff
The killing spree timer has been increased from 8s to 15s
Players can turn on pathing assistance to see signposts within the map that point to various points of interest and important objectives
Fixed an issue where Arena jungle buffs were spawning late. They will now spawn in at 00:00s.
Added some logic to the arena ticket calculations that brings it closer in line with SMITE 1
Over 14s, restore 8 mana and 9 health per second
Health Potion and Health Chalice Adjustment
Adjusted Healing on both of these from 20 hp per second for 10s to 15 hp per second for 14s
Increases total HP gained from 200 to 210, but takes longer to restore it.
Adjusted Mana Regen on both from 15 mana per second for 10s to 12 mana per second for 14s
Fixed an issue where stacking multiple potions was applying unintended amounts of Health/Mana regeneration

Leviathan’s Hide, Talisman of Purification, Gem of Focus, Tekko Kagi did not receive increased CDR related buffs as these items are already overperforming
Changed Damage vs Jungle Monsters and Bosses Scaling formula to no longer increase sharply to 1k damage at level 10.
The Damage formula will now be 200 Damage at level 1,  +25 damage per level, reaching 500 damage at lvl 14, capping at 500 damage.
Increased % max HP damage from 3% to 4%
Increased Passive Damage from 5 + 2 per level to 10 + 3 per level
Decreased Base Magical Protection from 40 to 30
Decreased Base Physical Protection from 40 to 30
Decreased Physical and Magical Protections provided by the passive ability from 50 to 40
Increased Passive threshold from 225 INT to 300 INT
Decreased CDR on Passive Effect from 15 to 10
Increased self heal per trigger from 60 to 100 health.
Fixed an issue where this item would go on cooldown even when a stack type was completed
Decreased Self Inflicted Damage from 5% max hp per second to 2.5% per second
(is also included in the CDR buffs)
Decreased Scaling Damage from 12.5% of your Protections to 10%
Now builds from Legionnaire Armor + Adroit Ring
Increased Passive Damage Scaling from 20% to 30%
Now builds from Cursed Sickle + Killing Stone
Now builds from Mana Tome + Sage’s Ring
Now is 1 stack, but the potion itself is more potent.
When consumed, you can ‘share’ the last drop with enemies, throwing it at them. This deals damage and applies Hysteria, allowing your teammates to help you get targets to Hysteria Thresholds
No longer provides bonus damage on max stacks. This damage was brought to the main kit overall.
Now causes targets at Max Hysteria to deal less damage to Baron Samedi.
This shift is to better support his Support playstyle, while keeping scaling high for his mage playstyle.
Now has protection scaling on the Power and Attack Speed reduction.
Now has Cooldown Rate Scaling. As you buy Cooldown Rate the missing health heal portion of this ability becomes more potent.
Reworked the Hysteria mechanic. Now when Wrap it Up hits an enemy god above the Hysteria threshold, the snake will explode 1.75s later, immediately dealing damage and mesmerizing enemies.
Now has protection scaling on the Max Health Damage.
Damage applies Hysteria, granting your abilities bonus effects when enough is applied. Your team can also purchase Baron's Brew from the item store.
Gods at Max Hysteria deal Reduced Damage to Baron Samedi
Baron's Brew can be thrown at enemies to apply Magical Damage and Hysteria
Hysteria drains at a rate of 2/s. This drain stops on the target for 5s when Baron Samedi applies Hysteria to them.
Summon skulls that deal Magical Damage in an X shape.
Deals bonus Magical Damage to enemies hit by the overlap
Hitting a god above 30 Hysteria applies a Strength, Intelligence, and Attack Speed Reduction
Vivid Gaze will trigger its Hysteria effect if its own damage bring targets above the Hysteria Threshold.
Call spirits that deal Magical Damage to enemies in an area.
Hitting a god Heals nearby allies for Missing Health
Hitting a god above 30 Hysteria makes the heal apply a Speed Buff and Slow Immunity
Allies within 8.8m of Baron Samedi or the center of Consign Spirits will receive the heal.
Throw a snake that constricts enemy gods, Slowing them to a Root.
Constricted gods take Magical Damage over 1.75s
Minions take a tick of Magical Damage when the snake passes through them
Hitting a god above 30 Hysteria causes the snake to explode when it Roots, applying a Mesmerize to nearby enemies
Enemies must be at or above 30 Hysteria when Wrap It Up hits to trigger its Hysteria effect.
The snake deals damage every 0.4375s, for a total of 5 ticks.
Open a Coffin that Vortexes enemies towards Baron Samedi. Gods Vortexed into the Coffin take Magical Damage and are Stunned.
The Vortex deals Magical Damage every 0.5s
Gods above 30 Hysteria are Vortexed with more intensity
All of Yemoja’s water based attacks/abilities can hit allied gods to provide them a Healing buff, Omi Healing
Hitting an ally with Moonstrike replaces Omi Healing with a new buff providing Basic Attack Damage and Attack Speed
Allies hit by River’s Rebuke gain both buff effects
Using River’s Rebuke provides half of missing Omi immediately
Duration of the regeneration buff is decreased based on the amount instantly restored
Allies hit will also gain Omi Healing.
Yemoja uses Omi to cast spells instead of Mana.
Yemoja's water based attacks and abilities can hit allies, providing them a Heal every 0.5s for 6s.
Additional Omi is gained at levels 5, 10 and 15.
Toss a bubble that bounces twice, dealing [Base + 30% INT] Magical Damage and Slows enemies before exploding into smaller bubbles.
Small bubbles deal [Base + 15% INT] Magical Damage
Enemies take reduced damage if hit by both large bubbles.
Allies hit will also gain Omi Healing.
This ability changes to Moonstrike when used.
The Moon strikes multiple times at a location dealing [Base + 15% INT] Magical Damage before a final strike dealing [Base + 40% INT] Magical Damage and Stunning enemies hit for 1s.
Allies in the final strike have their Omi Healing replaced with a buff providing increased Attack Speed and Basic Attack Damage.
Enemy structures hit by the final strike are stunned for 2s.
This ability changes to Bouncing Bubble when used.
Fire a water wave, dealing [Base + 40% INT] Magical Damage to enemies. This wave stops and bounces between allied gods, Healing them for and providing them a [Base + 15% INT] Health Shield.
This ability also does bonus damage to enemy Health Shields.
Projectile stops on walls or first allied god hit
Allies hit will also gain Omi Healing.
Create a water ring that Knock Backs anyone entering it.
Allies travel further and gain Movement Speed and Protections for 3s.
Placing the ring at the maximum distance reverses its direction.
Allies that use the ring also gain Omi Healing.
Conjure two large walls of water that block enemy movement and projectiles. After a delay they crash down dealing [Base + 70% INT] Magical Damage, Trembling and Slowing enemies hit.
Allies impacted by the crashing waves gain Omi Healing and Moonstrike's buff
You gain a buff of increased Omi over time on using this ability
Enemies are slowed by 60%, decreasing to normal over 3s.
You gain half of your missing Omi immediately but the duration of the regeneration buff is decreased based on the amount restored.

Anubis now gains 9 + 1 per level Magical and Physical Protection at all times

These base effects now become more potent as Anubis gains stacks from losing HP, up to 8 stacks. The protections are 2x at max stacks, and the lifesteal is 4x at max stacks, scaling linearly
